title: Construction of the composite radial retraction ψ₀ = R^ℓ of C ∖ La: (α), translation property (β), and the structural properties (S1), (S2)
statement: Notation: m, ℓ ∈ ℕ, d := m + 1 + ℓ, indices i range over Fin d, ℝ^d = Eucl d with the Euclidean norm |·|, C := [0,1]^d (y ∈ C iff 0 ≤ y_i ≤ 1 for all i), a ∈ ℝ^d with 1/4 < a_i < 3/4 for all i, and La := {y ∈ ℝ^d : there is a set J of indices with |J| = m + 2 and integers k_i with y_i − a_i = k_i for all i ∈ J}. Assume ℓ ≥ 1. There is a map ψ₀ : ℝ^d → ℝ^d such that (α) for every x ∈ C ∖ La, ψ₀(x) ∈ C and there is a set I of exactly ℓ indices with ψ₀(x)_i ∈ {0,1} for all i ∈ I; (β) for all x, x′ ∈ C ∖ La with x′_i − x_i ∈ ℤ for all i, ψ₀(x′)_i − ψ₀(x)_i = x′_i − x_i for all i; (S1): for every x ∈ C ∖ La for which there is a set I of exactly ℓ indices with x_i ∈ {0,1} for all i ∈ I, ψ₀(x) = x; and (S2): for every set J of indices with |J| ≥ m + 2, every c ∈ ℝ^d with c_i = a_i for i ∈ J and c_i ∈ {0,1} for i ∉ J, every x ∈ C ∖ La with x_i = c_i for i ∉ J, every y ∈ C and s > 0 with y_i − c_i = s·(x_i − c_i) for all i, and such that y_i ∈ {0,1} for some i ∈ J: ψ₀(y) = ψ₀(x). (Informal remark, not part of the statement: in (S2), (J, c) is a face F of C of dimension |J| ≥ m + 2 with centre c = a_F, and y is the point where the ray from a_F through x leaves F, i.e. y = ψ_F(x), the radial retraction of F with origin a_F; so (S2) is the parent's ψ₀ = ψ₀ ∘ ψ_F on F ∖ La, and (S1) says ψ₀ fixes the points of C ∖ La lying on faces of dimension ≤ m + 1.)
lean_statement: ∀ m ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ ℓ → ∀ a : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 1 / 4 < a i ∧ a i < 3 / 4) → ∀ La : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), La = {y | ∃ J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), J.card = m + 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ k : ℤ, y i - a i = k} → ∃ ψ₀ : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ) → Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∀ i, 0 ≤ ψ₀ x i ∧ ψ₀ x i ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ I : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), I.card = ℓ ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, ψ₀ x i = 0 ∨ ψ₀ x i = 1) ∧ (∀ x x' : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∀ i, 0 ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ 1) → x' ∉ La → (∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, x' i - x i = k) → ∀ i, ψ₀ x' i - ψ₀ x i = x' i - x i) ∧ (∀ x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∃ I : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), I.card = ℓ ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, x i = 0 ∨ x i = 1) → ψ₀ x = x) ∧ ∀ (J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ))) (c x y : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)) (s : ℝ), m + 2 ≤ J.card → (∀ i ∈ J, c i = a i) → (∀ i ∉ J, c i = 0 ∨ c i = 1) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∀ i ∉ J, x i = c i) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) → 0 < s → (∀ i, y i - c i = s * (x i - c i)) → (∃ i ∈ J, y i = 0 ∨ y i = 1) → ψ₀ y = ψ₀ x
